Opposing differential expression across cancer types indicates discordant tumor-associated alterations but does not establish tissue-specific oncogenic causality or therapeutic selectivity.

limitations: CPTAC differential expression analyses measure relative protein abundance fold changes between tumor and normal tissue within specific cohorts; they do not quantify absolute protein abundance, molecule counts, or molar concentrations.

Differences in fold change direction or magnitude across cancer types reflect cohort-level relative differential expression associations and cannot establish cell-of-origin mechanisms, functional consequences, or therapeutic target efficacy.
